title: Persist
subtitle: Draft and cache hydration
description: Optionally persist draft overrides and/or last source payload.
content: When `persist` is enabled, provide a `key` (or `persist.key`) for storage identity.

sections.title: Options
sections.content:
- `draft: true` — persist unsaved path overrides (debounced)
- `cache: true` — persist last source for hydrate when `data` is undefined
- `persist: true` — enables both draft and cache
- `driver` — `localStorage` (default) or `sessionStorage`
- `storage` / `db` — custom adapters (including qortex-db-style `del`)

sections.title: On successful save
sections.content: `resetDraft` also clears the persisted draft blob.
